notes: The one judgment call is Experiencer vs Agent for intransitive 'waits': the parse reads it as a stative intransitive (nothing moves or changes, like 'the crate sat in the bay'), which the test licenses, while reading waiting as an activity would hit the 'when unclear, Agent' fallback. Location on the event rather than LocatedIn is right, since 'wait' is not one of the stative locative verbs that mint no event.
